children: Volkswagen is recalling 208,724 vehicles in the United States over a steering rack bolt that can corrode and break, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said Friday. The regulator warned that the failure could cause a loss of steering control and raise the risk of a crash. Volkswagen shares fell 1.55% in Frankfurt.

Three model lines are affected. Certain 2018 Tiguan, 2018 and 2019 Atlas, and 2019 through 2021 Audi Q3 vehicles fall within the recall. Owners will get the right-side steering rack mounting bolt replaced free at dealers.

title: Volkswagen Recalls 208,724 Vehicles
